teacher: reply-search-256/8/64 self-play, sample every fourth round

candidate.features: 17 root-conditioned material/economy values plus 256 frozen routed-v6 spatial features per completed-turn candidate
candidate.head: 200-step map- and override-balanced pairwise linear teacher-choice imitation

decision: Reject the linear student. It loses to always taking static rank zero both in training and on independent validation maps; no full-game evaluation or rating was attempted. The reserved 6300000 full-game map window remains untouched.
diagnosis: The failure is not explained solely by the earlier tiny training set: 1024 maps and 1826 teacher override examples still gave many false overrides even in training. The reply-search teacher often accepts a substantial immediate static-score sacrifice for a substantial post-opponent-reply gain, and its chosen turn spans ranks one through seven. The present fixed linear post-turn features and equal-weight hard-choice objective do not reproduce that tactical response. The observation does not distinguish whether the remaining bottleneck is representation, head capacity, objective, or teacher-label stochasticity; those require controlled follow-up tests.
